newsitem.title: USA: Jan U.S. MTBE stocks down 1.1 pct to 9.7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Jan U.S. MTBE stocks down 1.1 pct to 9.7 mln.

text.p: U.S. inventories of MTBE dipped in January by 1.13 percent to 9.66 million barrels amid a stock build in the East Coast and draws in the Gulf and West Coasts, according to U.S. Department of Energy data.
The report, recently released by the DOE'S U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), also said output of MTBE fell by 12.5 pct to 161,000 barrels per day (bpd).

Stocks in the East Coast rose 35.4 pct, or 495,000 barrels, to 1.9 million barrels. Output in the key consumption region, where reformulated gasoline use is concentrated, was not provided in order to protect individual company data, EIA said.
Stocks in the key U.S. Gulf output region fell by 14 percent, or 577,000 barrels, to 3.54 million barrels, while USG output fell 14.3 pct to 138,000 barrels.
West Coast inventories fell 1.7 pct to 3.9 million barrels, with output data in the region also withheld, the EIA report showed.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk 212 859-1631
